classifiedReturns.excerpt:
ifact,
        completed.payload->'artifacts' AS artifacts,
        completed.payload AS guidance
      FROM tasks t
      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT te.payload
        FROM task_events te
        WHERE te.task_id = t.task_id
          AND te.kind = 'task.completed'
        ORDER BY te.id DESC
        LIMIT 1
      ) completed ON true
      ORDER BY t.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, t.id DESC
      LIMIT $1
      `,
      [limit]
    );

    res.status(200).json({ ok: true, tasks: r.rows || [] });
